title: the idle-mail proof runs its stand-in claude on Windows and reads UNRAN where the live ledger holds no poke
intention: test_an_idle_cc_session_is_told_it_has_mail.py launches its stand-in claude through sys.executable and its live-ledger tooth reads UNRAN where this host has no poke to measure.
why: Measured 2026-11-23: the stand-in is a shebang file Windows cannot execute, so claude_runs.jsonl stayed empty and 3 teeth failed; the shim was correct.
traces_to: Law 3 and Law 8 (a proof must measure the code, not the host); outline 9.4.8.1 (a tooth this host cannot run reads not-run); outline 10.3.2.1 (superclaude is Python on every box)
how: set shim._CLAUDE_CMD to [sys.executable, stand_in]; raise 'UNRAN: ...' in the live tooth on an absent ledger or no poked event, keeping a real red when pokes exist and none consume within 60 s; end the proof with run_teeth.

clauses.claim: an idle session is poked once, naming the target, by haiku, without the content
a busy session is not poked
a second delivery before consume is not poked
live mail to an idle session is consumed within 60 s, or the tooth's FAIL line says UNRAN where the host holds no poke

decisions.text: D1: set shim._CLAUDE_CMD to [sys.executable, stand_in]; raise 'UNRAN: ...' in the live tooth on an absent ledger or no poked event, keeping a real red when pokes exist and none consume within 60 s; end the proof with run_teeth.

out: cairn/devices/cc/superclaude (the bash launcher, retired by c3cd232ba0cf's last child)

measured.saw: On Windows 3 teeth failed because the shebang stand-in never ran; with [sys.executable, stand_in] 6 of 6 sandboxed teeth passed.
measured.how: ran the proof natively on akiendell (Windows) and read printed stdout; akiendelllinux ran branch akiendell/ab-proofs at e8deae9d0 under bin/cairn test --exec: all teeth ok
